title: Retakes and Dink Johnson on drums
summary: Some sides came out first take; Dink Johnson stamped his feet so loudly a mattress was needed.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Oh, some of them came out... All right. Orish Kriotramon came out good first time. First time, right? But those... You know, the vocals, you know, wait to go with them again.
And last time we had... Dink Johnson was playing on...
How did you happen to pick him?

Again, with the one... Wade wasn't there. Was seeing your band, Dink Johnson, here? Wade had stayed in... He stayed in Oakland. He didn't know where to go down. Oh, you picked Dink Johnson? He was still up in Los Angeles. Mm-hmm. And he spat his feet so loud, we had to go get a mattress or bed, so he put up...
